payload.domain: static deflection of slender elastic cantilever beams

chosen_hypothesis.statement: The reference steel cantilever's tip deflection under a 1000 N tip load matches the Euler-Bernoulli prediction within 2%.
chosen_hypothesis.rationale: HAND-FED (not stage-1 output): a known-servable fixed-summary claim to capture the calculix stage-2 model-visible surface at its birth (Packet B Phase 2 flip). Its 7-field spec is the R-B-1 tie spec: stage 3 stops loudly at selection, by design.
